narrative: The tech world is abuzz with AI advancements, particularly in financial management and cybersecurity with new models from Anthropic and OpenAI. Key infrastructure updates include the FAA finally moving past floppy disks and Cloudflare enhancing web security. Meanwhile, the broader technology market sees shifts in gaming accessibility, the rollout of new smart devices, and significant movements in the stock market with AI-related impacts.

highlights.title: EA is bringing 25 classic PC games to Steam
highlights.whyItMatters: This move by Electronic Arts makes a wealth of retro gaming titles accessible to modern players on a popular platform.

highlights.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI's potential public offering in 2027 signals significant growth and investor confidence in the rapidly expanding AI sector.

highlights.title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
highlights.whyItMatters: Anthropic's Claude AI introduces a personal finance feature, connecting directly to bank accounts via Plaid for automated financial management.

highlights.title: The FAA is finally ditching floppy disks
highlights.whyItMatters: The Federal Aviation Administration's transition away from floppy disks marks a significant modernization step for critical air traffic control systems.

highlights.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
highlights.whyItMatters: Google's new Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash model offers improved video generation and editing capabilities at a lower cost, enhancing AI media creation.

highlights.title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber focuses on improved vulnerability detection and reduced risk of unintended breaches, strengthening AI-powered cybersecurity.

highlights.title: Motorola Signature 27 with GrapheneOS support
highlights.whyItMatters: The new Motorola Signature 27 offers enhanced privacy and security features with GrapheneOS support, catering to users prioritizing data protection.

highlights.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's proactive defense against new PHP vulnerabilities highlights ongoing efforts to secure web infrastructure against emerging threats.
